Phase 1 tasks have concrete verify commands using existing repo tooling. No blocking issues found.

Issues:

- 2. [NOTE] P2-T1 verify commands rely solely on plan_readiness.py

issues.title: Markdown phase header stale vs state.json
issues.details: Plan markdown says 'Current Phase: P0 — Grounding' but state.json shows current_phase: 1 (Phase 1). The plan itself declares state.json as source of truth and markdown as supplementary, so this is cosmetic drift, not a routing risk.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the markdown 'Current Phase' line to 'P1 — Scoped Implementation' on the next plan edit.

issues.title: P2-T1 verify commands rely solely on plan_readiness.py
issues.details: Phase 2 exit criteria state 'docs, code, and tests agree on the landed S4 surface' but the only verify command is plan_readiness.py, which checks plan metadata, not code/test alignment. However, P1 already carries all code and test verification, and P2 is explicitly the doc-sync phase.
issues.suggested_fix: Consider adding a targeted grep or diff check in P2-T1 verify commands to confirm the YAML's Slice 3 deferral language was actually updated to reflect S4. Low priority since P1 verification covers the code surface.
